task: Require Platform Hard Limit > 0 in project Create/Update Budget popups (input and allocation slider), keeping legacy zero-platform projects renderable.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the hand-rolled softErrors/sumPctError submit gating in UnifiedProjectBudgetModal, but hard limits are derived from totalBudget*pct with several write paths (slider, typed hard input, CLI cascade, reset default, load from group), ordering-sensitive soft-scaling refs, and legacy zero-platform data that must still load. Pct-vs-dollar floor semantics and rounding can turn a tiny positive into 0. AC enumerates edge cases (legacy, soft=0, other categories) and test coverage for the modal, drag bar and category table is nearly absent, so bumped to L.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: AC enumerates edge/variant cases and no existing test template covers them
